about: Labeled questions for the answer eval, from both shops' help pages in the ai-support data. Each case lists the phrases a right answer must say and must not say, in lowercase, and whether a person should answer instead. Grow it with every wrong answer you find.

cases.question: How many days do I have to ask for a refund?
Can I return a knife I've already used?
Do you match a lower price from another store?
My mug arrived cracked. What are my options?
Can I send back an office chair after I've put it together?
Why was my card billed two times for one purchase?
How long do I have to return a desk lamp for a refund?
